verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'telemetry' mentions refer to customers' own observability data that Investigations analyses, not product usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
